original_title: Valor Mortis Gets Short Delay to Avoid September's Onslaught of Game Releases
summary_en: Action RPG Valor Mortis has strategically postponed its release to mid-October, opting out of a historically packed September. The developer aims to give players and the game itself more breathing room amidst intense competition.

en.title: Valor Mortis Delays October 13th Launch to Escape Crowded Release Window
en.summary: Action RPG Valor Mortis has strategically postponed its release to mid-October, opting out of a historically packed September. The developer aims to give players and the game itself more breathing room amidst intense competition.
en.body:
The gaming calendar for September 2026 was shaping up to be an absolute titan of releases, a veritable arms race that **Valor Mortis** has wisely decided not to participate in. Developer **One More Level**, the studio behind the acclaimed **Ghostrunner**, has announced a short delay for their upcoming action RPG, pushing its launch from September 24th to October 13th. The move is a clear concession to the overwhelming density of major game launches slated for the month.

This strategic shift comes as a response to what's being called one of the most crowded September release windows in recent memory. The initial September 24th date was chosen by the team because it appeared relatively clear, but the landscape shifted dramatically with subsequent announcements. Notably, **Control Resonant** and **Silent Hill: Townfall** are now also set to launch on the same day, with **Onimusha: Way of the Sword** arriving just one day later. This confluence of highly anticipated titles created a challenging environment for any new entrant.

> "We want to give Valor Mortis (and your wallet) some room to breathe," stated the development team in a press release.

Speaking with **Stephen Totilo** of Game File, **Blake Rochkind**, head of publisher **Lyrical Games**, elaborated on the decision. "As soon as Control announced September 24th, we knew we were moving the date. Candidly, I think Control looks like it might be a Game of the Year contender." Rochkind emphasized that the team is actively seeking a new date that offers a better chance for **Valor Mortis** to stand out, acknowledging the competitive pressure, which is further amplified by the looming shadow of **Grand Theft Auto VI**, expected later in the year.

## A Calculated Move in a Crowded Market

For fans eagerly awaiting **Valor Mortis**, this delay is more than just a minor inconvenience; it's a sign of a developer prioritizing the game's success and the player's experience. In an era where the sheer volume of releases can easily lead to titles getting lost in the shuffle, **One More Level** is making a proactive choice. By shifting to October 13th, they aim to carve out a more distinct space for their game, allowing players the financial and temporal freedom to fully engage with it without being overwhelmed by a deluge of other new releases. This thoughtful approach suggests a confidence in **Valor Mortis**'s quality and a desire to see it reach its full potential.

## What's Next for Valor Mortis

With the new release date set for October 13th, 2026, players now have a clearer target to anticipate. The delay allows **One More Level** and **Lyrical Games** to fine-tune any last-minute aspects of the game and focus their marketing efforts more effectively in the coming weeks. All eyes will be on how **Valor Mortis** performs when it finally launches into a slightly less frenzied, but still competitive, October gaming landscape.

tr.title: Valor Mortis 13 Ekim'e Ertelendi: Kalabalık Yayın Penceresinden Kaçış
tr.summary: Aksiyon RPG Valor Mortis, yoğun bir Eylül ayını kaçınmak için 13 Ekim'e ertelenmiştir. Geliştirici, oyunculara ve oyun kendisine daha fazla nefes alma alanı sağlamak için bu kararı almıştır. Eylül ayında birçok önemli oyunun yayınlanacağı bir dönemde, Valor Mortis'in ertelenmesi, geliştiricinin oyunun başarısına ve oyuncuların deneyimine öncelik verdiği anlamına geliyor.
tr.body:
Valor Mortis, Eylül 2026'nin en önemli oyun yayınlarından biri olarak görülmektedir. Ancak geliştirici One More Level, oyunun yayın tarihini 24 Eylül'den 13 Ekim'e ertelemiştir. Bu karar, Eylül ayında yayınlanacak diğer önemli oyunların yoğun rekabetine karşı bir hamle olarak görülmektedir.

**One More Level**, **Ghostrunner**'ın da geliştiricisi olan bir stüdyo, ve **Valor Mortis**'i 13 Ekim'de yayınlayacak. Bu erteleme, Eylül ayında yayınlanacak diğer önemli oyunların arasında kaybolma riskine karşı bir önlem olarak görülmektedir. Özellikle **Control Resonant** ve **Silent Hill: Townfall** gibi oyunların aynı gün yayınlanacağı düşünülürse, **Valor Mortis**'in ertelenmesi, geliştiricinin oyunun başarısına öncelik verdiği anlamına geliyor.

> "Oyunculara ve oyunlarına daha fazla nefes alma alanı vermek istiyoruz" diyor geliştirici ekibi.

**Lyrical Games**'in başkanı **Blake Rochkind**, **Stephen Totilo** ile yaptığı bir röportajda, "**Control**'ün yayın tarihini açıklamasıyla, biz de yayın tarihini değiştirdik. Açıkçası, **Control**'ün Yılın Oyunu adayı olabileceğini düşünüyorum" dedi. Rochkind, ekibin yeni bir yayın tarihi aradığını ve **Valor Mortis**'in diğer oyunların arasında kaybolma riskine karşı önlem aldıklarını belirtti.

## Kalabalık Piyasa İçin Hesaplı Bir Hamle

**Valor Mortis**'i bekleyen oyuncular için bu erteleme, sadece bir küçük aksaklık değil, geliştiricinin oyunun başarısına ve oyuncuların deneyimine öncelik verdiği anlamına geliyor. Yayınların yoğun olduğu bir dönemde, **One More Level** proaktif bir karar almış ve oyuna daha fazla nefes alma alanı sağlamak için yayın tarihini ertelemiştir. 13 Ekim'de yayınlanacak **Valor Mortis**, böylece diğer oyunların arasında kaybolma riskini azaltmış olacak.

## Valor Mortis İçin Sonraki Adımlar

13 Ekim'de yayınlanacak **Valor Mortis** için, oyuncular artık daha net bir hedefe odaklanabilir. Bu erteleme, **One More Level** ve **Lyrical Games**'e oyunun son dakika ayrıntılarını düzeltme ve pazarlama çabalarını daha etkili bir şekilde odaklama fırsatı sunuyor. Tüm gözler, **Valor Mortis**'in nihayet yayınlandığında nasıl bir performans göstereceğine çevrilecek.

es.title: Valor Mortis Retrasa su Lanzamiento a Octubre para Evitar una Ventana de Lanzamiento Congestionada
es.summary: El juego de rol de acción Valor Mortis ha pospuesto su lanzamiento a mediados de octubre, optando por evitar un septiembre históricamente congestionado. El desarrollador busca dar a los jugadores y al juego mismo más espacio para respirar en medio de una intensa competencia.
es.body:
La agenda de juegos para septiembre de 2026 se estaba configurando como un verdadero gigante de lanzamientos, un auténtico desafío que **Valor Mortis** ha decidido sabiamente no participar. El desarrollador **One More Level**, el estudio detrás del aclamado **Ghostrunner**, ha anunciado un retraso breve para su próximo juego de rol de acción, retrasando su lanzamiento desde el 24 de septiembre hasta el 13 de octubre. La decisión es una clara concesión a la densidad abrumadora de lanzamientos importantes programados para el mes.

Este cambio estratégico surge como respuesta a lo que se está llamando uno de los ventanales de lanzamiento más congestionados de septiembre en memoria reciente. La fecha inicial del 24 de septiembre fue elegida por el equipo porque parecía relativamente clara, pero el panorama cambió drásticamente con las posteriores anuncios. Destacan especialmente **Control Resonant** y **Silent Hill: Townfall**, que ahora también están programados para lanzarse el mismo día, con **Onimusha: Way of the Sword** llegando solo un día después. Esta confluencia de títulos altamente anticipados creó un entorno desafiante para cualquier nuevo entrante.

> "Queremos darle a Valor Mortis (y a tu billetera) un poco de espacio para respirar", declaró el equipo de desarrollo en un comunicado de prensa.

Al hablar con **Stephen Totilo** de Game File, **Blake Rochkind**, jefe de publicador **Lyrical Games**, se refirió a la decisión. "Tan pronto como Control anunció el 24 de septiembre, sabíamos que estábamos moviendo la fecha. Candidamente, creo que Control podría ser un contendiente al Juego del Año". Rochkind enfatizó que el equipo está buscando activamente una nueva fecha que ofrezca una mejor oportunidad para que **Valor Mortis** se destaque, reconociendo la presión competitiva, que se ve aún más agravada por la sombra inminente de **Grand Theft Auto VI**, esperado más adelante en el año.

## Un Movimiento Calculado en un Mercado Congestionado

Para los fans ansiosos por **Valor Mortis**, este retraso es más que una simple incomodidad menor; es una señal de un desarrollador que prioriza el éxito del juego y la experiencia del jugador. En una era donde el volumen abrumador de lanzamientos puede fácilmente llevar a los títulos a perderse en el revoltijo, **One More Level** está tomando una elección proactiva. Al cambiar a octubre 13, buscan crear un espacio más distintivo para su juego, permitiendo a los jugadores la libertad financiera y temporal para involucrarse plenamente con él sin estar abrumados por una deluge de otros lanzamientos nuevos. Esta enfoque atento sugiere una confianza en la calidad de **Valor Mortis** y un deseo de verlo alcanzar su máximo potencial.

## Próximos Pasos para Valor Mortis

Con la nueva fecha de lanzamiento establecida para el 13 de octubre de 2026, los jugadores ahora tienen un objetivo más claro para anticipar. El retraso permite a **One More Level** y **Lyrical Games** afinar cualquier aspecto final del juego y enfocar sus esfuerzos de marketing de manera más efectiva en las semanas venideras. Todos los ojos estarán puestos en cómo **Valor Mortis** se desempeña cuando finalmente se lanza en un octubre ligeramente menos frenético, pero todavía competitivo, panorama de juegos.

content_raw: Action RPG Valor Mortis has conceded defeat when it comes to the September gaming arms race and announced a short delay. Last week, it became abundantly clear that September is going to be one of the most crowded months for video game releases in history. It seems to be the rough cut-off for most game launches before GTA 6 hits the business like an atomic bomb. There are a couple of exceptions, like Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4, which is being released in October. However, it appears most other games don't want to be too close to the blast radius of GTA 6. Of course, the overwhelming amount of September releases means that the situation arguably isn't much better for some games. As a result, Valor Mortis (a game that announced its release date on Sunday), has decided to push into October to have a better chance. The game will now arrive on October 13th. "We want to give Valor Mortis (and your wallet) some room to breathe," said developer One More Level in a statement . When speaking with Stephen Totilo from Game File , the team behind the game noted that they had previously chosen September 24th as a release date because it looked very clear – and then Control Resonant and Silent Hill: Townfall chose to release on the same day. To make matters worse, Onimusha: Way of the Sword's release date falls the day after, on September 25th. "As soon as Control announced September 24th, we knew we were moving the date," said Blake Rochkind, head of publisher at Lyrical Games. "Candidly, I think Control looks like it might be a Game of the Year contender." Rochkind immediately sent a message to the development team about changing the date and tried to strategically pick a new one that wouldn't be slammed by competition, but held the announcement until after the Nintendo Direct to make sure there weren't any massive games arriving on their new date. From the creators of Ghostrunner, Valor Mortis is a first-person soulslike where you'll rise from death as a former soldier of Napoleon’s army, only to die over and over again battling shambling corpses and wild monsters. You can get a rundown on Valor Mortis in our recent preview. Cade Onder is a freelancer for IGN's news team. He covers all things entertainment, including gaming, film, and more. You can find him on Twitter @Cade_Onder.
